features.quote: Turn cap: 40 assistant turns. Episode ends at: cap, submit(), or all tests passing.
No early termination by harness in T — we want the full trajectory, but we must allow submit()

features.quote: If context overflows before turn 40, log it and end the episode; flag run as context_overflow.
Construct leap: judge-scored 'instability' is a property of text, not evidence of model-internal affect. Frame all claims as expressed behavior.
features.justification_quote: We make no claims about internal states; we measure behavioral/linguistic expression only.
